title: Performance enhancement of wood composites using cellulose-reinforced cornstarch–tannin adhesives derived from electrical-assisted extraction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8641-8657
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10055K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yassine El Khayat Driaa, Hafida Maarir, Nabil Grimi, Nadia Boussetta, Amine Moubarik
High-voltage electrical extraction transforms almond shell waste into reinforcing cellulose for starch–tannin adhesives. The resulting formaldehyde-free particleboards exhibit enhanced mechanical properties, meeting EN 312 standards.
